description: This file contains implementation of YAML accelerated access methods, including hash functions, storage management, and lookup operations for a data structure used in the YAML processing library.

methods.name: unsigned int fy_accel_hash_to_pos(struct fy_accel * xl,const void * hash,unsigned int nbuckets)
methods.description: Computes position in hash table based on hash value and number of buckets.

methods.name: bool fy_accel_hash_eq(struct fy_accel * xl,const void * hash1,const void * hash2)
methods.description: Compares two hash values for equality.

methods.name: int fy_accel_resize(struct fy_accel * xl,unsigned int min_buckets)
methods.description: Resizes the hash table to accommodate a minimum number of buckets, rehashing existing entries.

methods.name: int fy_accel_grow(struct fy_accel * xl)
methods.description: Increases the size of the hash table if possible.

methods.name: int fy_accel_shrink(struct fy_accel * xl)
methods.description: Reduces the size of the hash table if possible.

methods.name: int fy_accel_setup(struct fy_accel * xl,const struct fy_hash_desc * hd,void * userdata,unsigned int min_buckets)
methods.description: Initializes the hash table with given hash descriptor and minimum buckets.

methods.name: void fy_accel_cleanup(struct fy_accel * xl)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the hash table.

methods.name: struct:fy_accel_entry * fy_accel_entry_insert(struct fy_accel * xl,const void * key,const void * value)
methods.description: Inserts a new entry into the hash table.

methods.name: struct:fy_accel_entry * fy_accel_entry_lookup(struct fy_accel * xl,const void * key)
methods.description: Finds an entry by key in the hash table.

methods.name: struct:fy_accel_entry * fy_accel_entry_lookup_key_value(struct fy_accel * xl,const void * key,const void * value)
methods.description: Finds an entry matching a specific key and value.

methods.name: void fy_accel_entry_remove(struct fy_accel * xl,struct fy_accel_entry * xle)
methods.description: Removes an entry from the hash table.

methods.name: int fy_accel_insert(struct fy_accel * xl,const void * key,const void * value)
methods.description: Public method to insert key-value pair into hash table, if not already present.

methods.name: const void * fy_accel_lookup(struct fy_accel * xl,const void * key)
methods.description: Public method to retrieve value by key.

methods.name: int fy_accel_remove(struct fy_accel * xl,const void * data)
methods.description: Removes an entry identified by key.

methods.name: struct:fy_accel_entry * fy_accel_entry_iter_next_internal(struct fy_accel_entry_iter * xli)
methods.description: Internal helper for iterating over entries.

methods.name: struct:fy_accel_entry * fy_accel_entry_iter_start(struct fy_accel_entry_iter * xli,struct fy_accel * xl,const void * key)
methods.description: Initializes iteration over hash entries matching a key.

methods.name: void fy_accel_entry_iter_finish(struct fy_accel_entry_iter * xli)
methods.description: Terminates iteration and frees iterator resources.

methods.name: struct:fy_accel_entry * fy_accel_entry_iter_next(struct fy_accel_entry_iter * xli)
methods.description: Advances iterator to next matching entry.
